reviews.title: Works Great Until…
reviews.text:
I recorded calls and interviews with my father over at three years. When he passed away, I wanted to export the calls that’s not possible. You can open the call click the share and download, but it gives you a unique number. That means nothing.

So I texted support ask them to help me export my dad’s phone calls. They are professional run around Artists. They will not help me. 

They said press all four fingers down when you’re in the app and then send a support request  that’s not possible it doesn’t show up. No Webb interface no way to export without manually doing it and it’s very tedious when you have hundreds of phone calls.

So I’m trapped paying every week until I spend the hours and hours I need to manually export all of these.

Bent Spoons Tape This.

reviews.title: Can’t merge
reviews.text: Can you please update your app??!! This app was my go to. I used it every day. Now I can no longer merge calls. It is worthless. I have to find a new app

reviews.title: $520 / year is criminal.
reviews.text: This app is more expensive than phone service. It used to be 69 / year. Now it’s 9.99 a week. Criminal pricing. Boooo!

reviews.title: Lost everything. No support. Avoid.
reviews.text: After using this app for over 10 years, I cannot sign back in and there is zero support outside of an AI machine. I will be looking for another app. Lost everything. Backing up is also extremely tedious. Avoid.
